# nexspence_repository (Data Source)

Look up one repository by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nexspence_repository" "maven_releases" {
  name = "maven-releases"
}

output "maven_releases_url" {
  value = data.nexspence_repository.maven_releases.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `format` (String)
- `online` (Boolean)
- `type` (String)
- `url` (String)
